confidence_notes: Food anchors use recent city cost-of-living prices. Accommodation is a holistic year-typical estimate; cocktail and wine prices are less certain and are bounded using local bar-price ranges relative to the beer benchmark.
comparable_city_reasoning: Florence's concentrated cultural tourism supports a three-star room modestly above Milan and Sorrento, with hostel prices above the Catania, Sorrento and Milan benchmarks. Basic rooms are estimated below those cities' midrange comparables.
